ATMExceptionAcknowledgement2: Information related to the acknowledgment of an ATM exception.
ATMExceptionAcknowledgementV02: The ATMExceptionAcknowledgment message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMExceptionAdvice message.
ATMReconciliationAcknowledgement3: Information related to the acknowledgment of an ATM reconciliation from the ATM. manager.
ATMReconciliationAcknowledgementV03: The ATMReconciliationAcknowledgment message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMReconciliationAdvice message.
HostToATMAcknowledgement1: Information related to the acknowledgment from an ATM to contact the ATM manager.
HostToATMAcknowledgementV01: The HostToATMAcknowledgment message is sent by an ATM to a host to acknowledge the receipt of a HostToATMRequest message.
